metadata.question: Are there more red flowers visible on April 21, 2018, than on May 7, 2018, in Keukenhof Garden in the Netherlands?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) over Keukenhof (point 52.270468, 4.546351 buffered 800 m).
- Dates: 2018-04-21 and 2018-05-07. If no image on exact date, widen to ±3 days. If still none, fallback to Sentinel-2 L1C (COPERNICUS/S2).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds and shadows.
- S2_SR: Keep SCL classes 4 (vegetation) and 5 (bare soil); exclude clouds/shadows/water.
- S2 L1C: Mask QA60 bits 10 (clouds) and 11 (cirrus).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Compute valid (cloud-free) area; if 0 => C2.
- Compute red-flower proxy using RCC (R/(R+G+B)) > 0.42, NDVI < 0.25, R > 0.1, R > 1.1*G, R > 1.1*B, brightness > 0.2.
- If any numeric is null/NaN or invalid (e.g., fraction outside [0,1]) => C3.
- Compare red fraction among valid pixels; if Apr21 > May07 => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([4.546351, 52.270468]).buffer(800).bounds();
    const roiAreaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea();
    const roiAreaDict = roiAreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const roiArea = (await roiAreaDict.getNumber('area').getInfo()) || (await ee.Number(roi.area(1)).getInfo());
    const roiAreaKm2 = roiArea / 1e6;

    // Helper: build collections
    function s2srCol(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
    }
    function s2l1cCol(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
    }

    // Cloud masks
    function maskS2SR(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const good = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)); // vegetation or bare soil
      return img.updateMask(good);
    }
    function maskS2L1C(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBit = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBit = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }

    // Get composite for a date with fallback
    async function getComposite(targetDateStr) {
      const day = ee.Date(targetDateStr);
      const dayEnd = day.advance(1, 'day');
      let type = null;
      // Try S2_SR exact day
      let col = s2srCol(day, dayEnd);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size > 0) {
        type = 'S2_SR_d0';
      } else {
        // Try S2_SR ±3 days
        const start3 = day.advance(-3, 'day');
        const end3 = day.advance(4, 'day');
        col = s2srCol(start3, end3);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size > 0) {
          type = 'S2_SR_d3';
        } else {
          // Fallback L1C ±3 days
          col = s2l1cCol(start3, end3);
          size = await col.size().getInfo();
          if (size > 0) {
            type = 'S2_d3';
          } else {
            // Fallback L1C exact day
            col = s2l1cCol(day, dayEnd);
            size = await col.size().getInfo();
            if (size > 0) {
              type = 'S2_d0';
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return { col, size, type };
    }

    // Compute metrics for a date
    async function analyzeDate(label, dateStr) {
      const comp = await getComposite(dateStr);
      if (!comp.type || comp.size === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', label };
      }
      let img = comp.col.median().clip(roi);
      const coverageMask = img.select('B4').mask(); // potential data coverage
      // Apply cloud mask depending on type
      if (comp.type.startsWith('S2_SR')) {
        img = maskS2SR(img);
      } else {
        img = maskS2L1C(img);
      }
      const proj = img.select('B4').projection();

      // Scale reflectance
      const blue = img.select('B2').multiply(0.0001);
      const green = img.select('B3').multiply(0.0001);
      const red = img.select('B4').multiply(0.0001);
      const nir = img.select('B8').multiply(0.0001);

      const sumRGB = red.add(green).add(blue).max(1e-6);
      const rcc = red.divide(sumRGB);
      const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red).max(1e-6));

      // Valid (cloud-free) mask vs potential coverage
      const potentialBinary = ee.Image(1).updateMask(coverageMask);
      const validBinary = ee.Image(1).updateMask(img.mask().reduce(ee.Reducer.min()));

      // Red flower proxy mask
      const redCond = rcc.gt(0.42)
        .and(ndvi.lt(0.25))
        .and(red.gt(0.10))
        .and(red.gt(green.multiply(1.1)))
        .and(red.gt(blue.multiply(1.1)))
        .and(sumRGB.gt(0.20));
      const redBinary = ee.Image(0).where(redCond, 1).updateMask(validBinary.mask());

      // Areas (km2), aggregated to 1000 m
      const areaRed = redBinary.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceResolution({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), maxPixels: 65535 })
        .reproject({ crs: proj, scale: 1000 })
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('constant');
      const areaValid = validBinary.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceResolution({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), maxPixels: 65535 })
        .reproject({ crs: proj, scale: 1000 })
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('constant');
      const areaPotential = potentialBinary.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceResolution({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), maxPixels: 65535 })
        .reproject({ crs: proj, scale: 1000 })
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('constant');

      const vals = await ee.Dictionary({
        red: areaRed,
        valid: areaValid,
        potential: areaPotential
      }).getInfo();

      if (vals === null) {
        return { status: 'C3', label };
      }
      const validKm2 = (vals.valid || 0) / 1e6;
      const redKm2 = (vals.red || 0) / 1e6;
      const potentialKm2 = (vals.potential || 0) / 1e6;

      if (!isFinite(validKm2) || !isFinite(redKm2) || !isFinite(potentialKm2)) {
        return { status: 'C3', label };
      }
      if (validKm2 <= 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', label, imgs: comp.size, type: comp.type };
      }
      // Fractions
      const redFracValid = redKm2 / validKm2;
      const cloudPct = potentialKm2 > 0 ? Math.max(0, 100 * (1 - validKm2 / potentialKm2)) : null;
      if (redFracValid < 0 || redFracValid > 1 || cloudPct === null || !isFinite(redFracValid) || !isFinite(cloudPct)) {
        return { status: 'C3', label };
      }

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        label,
        imgs: comp.size,
        type: comp.type,
        validKm2,
        redKm2,
        redFracValid,
        cloudPct
      };
    }

    // Analyze both dates
    const a = await analyzeDate('2018-04-21', '2018-04-21');
    const b = await analyzeDate('2018-05-07', '2018-05-07');

    // Handle cases
    console.log(`ROI km2: ${roiAreaKm2.toFixed(3)}`);
    if (a.status !== 'OK' || b.status !== 'OK') {
      if (a.status === 'C1' || b.status === 'C1') {
        console.log(`Apr21 status: ${a.status}, May07 status: ${b.status}`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      if (a.status === 'C2' || b.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`Apr21 status: ${a.status}${a.imgs ? ` (imgs:${a.imgs} ${a.type||''})` : ''}, May07 status: ${b.status}${b.imgs ? ` (imgs:${b.imgs} ${b.type||''})` : ''}`);
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      console.log(`Apr21 status: ${a.status}, May07 status: ${b.status}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence lines
    console.log(`Apr21 imgs:${a.imgs} ${a.type}, Valid km2:${a.validKm2.toFixed(3)}, Cloud%:${a.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}, Red km2:${a.redKm2.toFixed(3)}, Red/Valid%:${(a.redFracValid*100).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`May07 imgs:${b.imgs} ${b.type}, Valid km2:${b.validKm2.toFixed(3)}, Cloud%:${b.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}, Red km2:${b.redKm2.toFixed(3)}, Red/Valid%:${(b.redFracValid*100).toFixed(2)}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(a.redFracValid) || !isFinite(b.redFracValid)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const answer = (a.redFracValid > b.redFracValid) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
